title: Boodoh roocitte
intro: Atu racmatta sinni mirac dirab rabbitte qigdu diini essere wakti fan safarta. Dagoo ayyunti diggale rooci cineenih, kee foocal digaala kaxxam gibdi toh amotani abaaro tekke. Ken aydaadi Qur'aanal qagaaqagitak geytima imaan aggiriqqe sinni sumaaqa. Atu tama diggale butta baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Nanu elle mannownam dirab yallih qibaadah essera miraacah qanxaffeh gubat yan baaxol
Ni ayyuntal kaxxa gibdaabinittet garayte dibuk Yallal dibuk naamineemih sabbatah.
amoyti amriseh too kaxxa boodo cottam kee gibdi girah siraglele
kah kinnim nanu ninni amanti cabnam cinneh, nanu woo girah boodot tiya tiyah qidne
Ni aydaadi Qur'aanak exxak teyna yekkeeh, nee qanbise mari amotani abaaro le
Ni gibdaabinat taysaqarrimeh tan suura qaran bagul tan kaxxa qaran astootih migaaqal muggaqsimte

trial.label: Ni gibbatu
options: kullumta admo diini ayro rabboh ayro

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: qeltut tan gabla kibal le kuta luk
Dumaahi finqitteh tan magaalak xer qamiddu
Fakut tan booxa caylale silaytut fiyte

outcome.label: Ni Xaloot
options: Nanu nadaamak sugneeh, gadaama amotani abaaro luk sugne
Nanu ninni qellatah damaaqe fan milaagimne
Inki finqah yan weeqa ni mano tiggileh
outcome.answer: Nanu nadaamak sugneeh, gadaama amotani abaaro luk sugne

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
